title: Reproducible supported runtime for release certification
statement: The supported release runtime is reproducible on Node 24.21.0/npm 11.19.0: clean npm ci completed without lockfile drift, the Package 00R CI passed, and the release gate passed.
decision_impact: No longer blocks Package 00R certification; future packages must continue using the supported Node/npm contract.
resolution: Resolved by Package 00R evidence; the prior Node 22/npm 10 uncertainty no longer blocks certification.

title: Package 02 operational auth bootstrap details
statement: Exact bootstrap/session/organization-membership implementation details must be confirmed against the chosen Supabase project/environment before enabling auth paths.
decision_impact: Affects safe enablement order for Auth/Organization bootstrap in Package 02.

title: Which OG documents certify the current technical mappings
statement: Current code contains operational support/equalizer/vehicle mappings, but the exact validated OG source set that certifies each mapping must be attached/indexed before those mappings can be promoted to Confirmada OG outside implementation behavior.
decision_impact: Determines which technical mappings may be used automatically in customer-facing applications/quotes and which must remain Precisa validar.

title: Promote compiled domain knowledge into runtime Knowledge Command Center after review
statement: The new agent-facing Skills/playbooks/context are available to repository agents immediately, while live Sales Brain/KCC uses its private imported knowledge index; decide which reviewed stable domain records should be ingested into that runtime index without importing volatile CRM facts or unvalidated OG claims.
decision_impact: Controls whether the live Call AI/Communication runtime receives the same compiled stable playbooks and technical guardrails or whether this first package remains agent/developer intelligence only.
